subject: Money
title: Robot Tax
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Robot Tax.

hook.text: Bill Gates proposed taxing robots in 2017. If a machine replaces a worker, tax the machine.

buildup.text: When a human works, income tax and payroll tax are collected. Replace them with a robot and revenue vanishes.

discovery.text: A robot tax would slow automation and fund retraining for displaced workers.

twist.text: Critics say it would make countries less competitive. Nations that don't tax robots would attract firms.

climax.text: We tax labor but not capital that replaces it. The tax system was built for human workers.

punchline.text: The tax code hasn't met the future yet.

quiz.question: Why did Bill Gates propose a robot tax?
options: To replace lost tax revenue from displaced workers
